cd /workspace/dev && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
src=open('fixtures.py').read()
anchor = "# --- multi release catalog order ---"
extra = '''# --- cross-length priority and start offsets --------------------------------
disc = [row(0, [1600, 1400, 20, 20, 20, 20, 20], [100, 100, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]),
        row(0, [1600, 1400, 20, 20, 20, 20, 20], [100, 100, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]),
        row(0, [1600, 1400, 1600, 20, 20, 20, 20, 20], [100, 100, 100, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]),
        row(0, [1600, 1400, 1600, 20, 20, 20, 20, 20], [100, 100, 100, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0])]
rel = release('r', width=3, eps=(0, 1), discovery=disc,
              validation=[{'class': 0, 'values': [1600, 1400, 1600]},
                          {'class': 0, 'values': [1600, 1400, 1600]},
                          {'class': 0, 'values': [1600, 1400]}])
OUT = run(req([rel], []))
check('cross length clusters', [(c['id'], c['range']) for c in OUT['catalog'][0]['clusters']],
      [(0, [[1600, 1600], [1400, 1400]]), (2, [[1600, 1600], [1400, 1400], [1600, 1600]])])
check('cross length hits', [c['hits'] for c in OUT['catalog'][0]['clusters']], [[1], [2]])
check('cross length scores', [c['score'] for c in OUT['catalog'][0]['clusters']],
      [[10000, 3], [20000, 3]])
check('cross length priority', OUT['catalog'][0]['priority'], [2, 0])
OUT = run(req([rel], [['install', 'r'], ['open', 'f'], ['packet', 'f', 0, 0, 7],
                      ['packet', 'f', 1, 0, 86], ['packet', 'f', 2, 1, 114],
                      ['packet', 'f', 3, 0, 86], ['close', 'f']]))
check('start offset', OUT['decisions'][0], {
    'flow': 'f', 'epoch': 0, 'release': 'r', 'at': 5, 'seen': 4, 'class': 0,
    'reason': 'segment', 'rule': 2, 'start': 1})
# the length-2 pattern only matches when the length-3 one does not
OUT = run(req([rel], [['install', 'r'], ['open', 'f'], ['packet', 'f', 0, 0, 7],
                      ['packet', 'f', 1, 0, 86], ['packet', 'f', 2, 1, 114], ['close', 'f']]))
check('shorter pattern wins alone', (OUT['decisions'][0]['rule'], OUT['decisions'][0]['start'],
                                     OUT['decisions'][0]['seen']), (0, 1, 3))

# --- two runs in one row ----------------------------------------------------
disc = [row(0, [1600, 20, 20, 1400, 1700, 20, 20, 1300, 1800],
            [200, 0, 0, 0, 200, 0, 0, 0, 200])]
# activations 200 at isolated positions -> runs of length 1 -> discarded
check('isolated highs discarded', run(req([release('r', discovery=disc)], []))['catalog'][0]['fragments'], [])
disc = [row(0, [1600, 1601, 20, 20, 1400, 1401, 20, 20, 20, 20],
            [200, 200, 0, 0, 200, 200, 0, 0, 0, 0])]
OUT = run(req([release('r', discovery=disc)], []))
check('two runs one row', OUT['catalog'][0]['fragments'], [[0, 0, 2], [0, 4, 2]])
check('two runs one cluster', [(c['id'], c['members']) for c in OUT['catalog'][0]['clusters']], [])
disc = disc+[row(0, [1600, 1601, 20, 20, 1400, 1401, 20, 20, 20, 20],
                 [200, 200, 0, 0, 200, 200, 0, 0, 0, 0])]
OUT = run(req([release('r', discovery=disc, validation=[{'class': 0, 'values': [1600, 1601]},
                                                         {'class': 0, 'values': [1400, 1401]}])], []))
check('two runs two clusters', [(c['id'], c['members']) for c in OUT['catalog'][0]['clusters']],
      [(0, [0, 2]), (1, [1, 3])])

# --- multi release catalog order ---'''
assert anchor in src
src = src.replace(anchor, extra, 1)
open('fixtures.py','w').write(src)
PYEOF
cd /workspace/dev && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native SYNECDOCHE_SITE=/workspace/site PYTHONPATH=/workspace/site python3 fixtures.py 2>&1 | grep -vE "^ok " | head -30
